review_reference: UNSIGNED DRAFT: awaits the owner's signature of 0162-0167 and of runtime-grants.sql at the sha256s in files, after Rahman's re-check. The numbers are provisional: the coordinator closes them up at integration in release order (0154, Appointments, Billing, Emergency; one department per release; #258 7168672285 and 7175579690), which changes every sha256 again, so the owner signs only the renumbered files. No function body of 0162-0167 names a migration number (the three that did now name the object instead: commercial.bill_recompute, ORD-12's refills and ORD-7's ehr.catalog_facility_items), so closing the numbers up keeps every md5 the post-checks pin and only the sha256s change. This declaration claims no signature. BILL-1 patient billing release 1 with pharmacy point-of-care stock (Release D, the department sprint the owner approved on 25 November 2026; hid-system#336), built at the recommended option of each open question (BILL-7 to BILL-17), not yet answered by the owner, and switched off at real facilities (COMMERCIAL_BILLING_ENABLED, COMMERCIAL_PAY_BEFORE_ENABLED, COMMERCIAL_ONLINE_PAYMENT_ENABLED). Releases after 0001-0153 (backend release E, live since 25 November 2026 17:04 UTC). runtime-grants.sql is release E's signed file (49b378f5...) plus the BILL-1 block, unchanged otherwise. Rahman's final check of 6b253568 (#336, 25 November 2026, 20:53 and 21:46 UTC): commercial.outstanding uses no temporary table, and no billing or stock function names one; a dispensing reversal cancels only the line that bills that dispensing (commercial.bill_lines.dispensing_id, set by the first dispensing past the gate), so a refill's reversal never takes a first fill's charge off or shows a paid first fill as refund due, and a refill (ORD-12's fill_number above 1, read from the row so 0167 works with or without 0154) of a billed work item is refused REFILL_BILLING_NOT_AVAILABLE until refills are billed; bill and receipt numbers keep every digit past 999999; the post-checks pin each table's policy (permissive, PUBLIC, USING and WITH CHECK) and exact triggers (type, enabled, arguments, columns, WHEN, function), 0167's triggers likewise, and 0162's rewritten role functions' SECURITY DEFINER, search_path and grants; a till day's opening and counted cash may be up to 100,000,000,000 kobo (Rahman's suggested bound, for the owner to confirm); money over a bill is listed (status money_over), summed (bill_summary's moneyOver) and marked in the HMO receivables (overBill); an index serves the work list's bill badge; pay-before reads the bill FOR SHARE; 0164 also locks the two 0163 tables its foreign keys use; a nameless walk-in reads "Walk-in" everywhere. Rahman's release-order items (#258, 21:48 UTC): 0162 requires the 0001-0151 codes as a subset and none of its own, and its already-applied check compares only its own rows (roles, codes, its 58 role rows, its 77 audit rows), so a re-run on an integrated database answers "already applied"; 0167 requires each of the six tables it hooks to have exactly Release C's triggers, and accepts on ehr.visit_queue exactly the Emergency board's two (visit_queue_ed_close_mirror, type 17, and visit_queue_ed_guard, type 19, by name, type and function), both or neither, and nothing else; the release verifier has no booked-number exception (numbers closed up at integration instead). Billing's release also names (Rahman, #258 7175579690, "What each declaration must name"): gateway/nginx.conf.template at sha256 c7278db2e2ab049ed5f60bd461283070deea83bee700c061375408a26cf913d7 (ehr-api serves seven /api/v1/commercial/ billing prefixes; pricing and demo requests stay on identity-api), with the gateway OpenVEX re-bound to that sha256 (VEX re-bind: security/gateway-runtime.vex.json, version 3, Q291 A); and the identity-api window: once 0162 is applied, Release E's identity-api image offers cashier and billing_officer for invitation, so the new identity-api image is deployed straight after 0162 (Rahman's final check of #336, 7175546496: acceptable only so; nothing is written wrongly). Coordinator decision, option 2 (#258, 25 November 2026, 23:10 UTC): 0163 accepts ORD-7's facility items (HID-FACILITY and the item's id) for drugs and lab tests, checked at write time against this facility's active item of the kind in 0155's table when 0155 is applied (only the schema owner's own ordinary table; before 0155, NATIONAL_CODE_NOT_FOUND), and the price list, 0166's stock and 0167's hooks match them by the code pair as national codes; another facility's facility code is not counted as unpriced. Left for the owner: Rahman's item 7 (a cashier can turn a Health ID into a name through bill_attach_patient) and item 8 (a reversal on a bill with other lines can show an HMO cover or a waiver as refund due), BILL-17 (the two QA mailboxes), and the cash bound. Left for the coordinator: whether 0163's facility-item check should read 0155's table (built so) or check the form only (Ola's question 1, #258 12:44 UTC). 0154 at 9d41866c refused after these files by its own pin of pharmacy.dispensings' five triggers; ORD-12's re-hash (3f14f202, 0154 at 2b19ff3f...) accepts exactly zz_billing_stock_and_gate as the optional sixth and applies after them.
evidence: On a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.16 container (pgvector) with fictional data only, at the sha256s below (26 November 2026, after the review of bd427a88). Base: 0001-0153 (live 0cfddcc9's files) applied by the repo runner (MIGRATION_TARGET=rds) as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS migrator, then Release E's runtime-grants.sql (49b378f5...) and the runtime-roles suite as the bootstrap runs them. On a copy: plan 6 pending, dry run rolled back, apply 6, plan 0 pending; 0163 and 0167 run again answer already applied (their pinned md5s match the live functions); this runtime-grants.sql and the runtime-roles suite pass; patient-billing passes 286 cases, and the seven older suites this branch adjusts pass; services/ehr-api/scripts/verify-patient-billing-runtime.mjs passes. Facility items with 0155 applied: on a copy with a fictional table of 0155's shape made by the migrator (Ola's note, #258 7192389223: owned by the schema owner, FORCE row security, an owner read policy only, runtime read, insert and update at the session's facility, NOT NULL display, row_version, key, request sha256 and creator columns without defaults, a medicine's generic name required, the kind an enum, a generated tsvector, composite foreign keys, a guard trigger refusing writes outside its own path), patient-billing passes 286 cases; bd427a88's suite stops at section 13 (line 1429) with that guard's refusal, and with the guard dropped with "new row violates row-level security policy for table catalog_facility_items" (the review's reproduction), so no case was reported. Without 0155 the suite's stand-in now has that shape too (no owner write policy), and a mutant of this suite that writes it as the owner stops the same way. Migration mechanics (test-patient-billing-migrations.mjs, on the 0001-0153 template) pass, now also: no function body of the six names a migration number; the six closed up (renamed 0154-0159, every number from 0154 on rewritten in their text, as an integrator would) apply with every post-check and each re-run answers "already applied" under its new number. bd427a88's files fail both: the body check names commercial.facility_item_ok, commercial.hook_dispensing and commercial.hook_dispensing_reversal, and closed up its 0163 (as 0155) refuses "0155: post-check failed: functions differ: commercial.facility_item_ok(text,text)". As before: each of 0163-0167 refuses 55000 on the live schema alone; another lane's code on four shared roles and the Emergency board's two triggers on ehr.visit_queue are accepted and kept, and 0162 run again after later files add a Billing code to the nurse, another code to the cashier and rewrite staff_invitable_roles answers already applied; 0167 refuses another lane's trigger on ehr.visit_queue or pharmacy.dispensings, one of the Emergency board's two alone, and either with another function or type; a lost 0001-0151 code makes 0162 refuse and a lost Release C trigger makes 0167 refuse; each file refuses 55P03 with its own number while a table it locks is held, then applies, and its re-run answers already applied; two payments at once never overpay; 21 bills from four sessions have no gaps; a payment during a day close waits and is refused TILL_DAY_NOT_OPEN. Release order at the other lanes' origin heads now (ORD-12 3f14f202: 0154 2b19ff3f...; Appointments 5f598ada: 0160 cece2bf3..., 0161 04d84233...; the Emergency board ed76bf41: 0168 84790e95..., 0169 9aa42c47...): repo runner plan, dry run, apply and plan 0 at each step of 0154, Appointments, Billing, Emergency; every Billing file run again answers already applied; Release E's file plus the four blocks in release order, the runtime-roles suite and patient-billing (286 cases) pass. db:test-staging-upgrade (HID_BASELINE_RUNTIME_GRANTS = Release E's file) passes: baseline 154, integrated 160, dry run rolled back, the migrations grant exactly what runtime-grants.sql grants (2878 privileges), no row-level security change on 231 tables, a clean install, the no-FORCE baseline. Release tests: 123 of 126 pass; the three that fail refuse "missing migration prefix" for the absent 0154-0161 (no booked-number exception); on a copy with 0162-0167 closed up to 0154-0159 (names only, test-only), 126 of 126 pass and verify-release-contract verifies. verify-migration-ledger accepts 0167 (160 files). Carried from the previous round, at bd427a88's files (which differ from these only in three function-body comments and their md5 pins): Billing after Appointments alone, after the Emergency board alone and before 0154 (0154 at 2b19ff3f... accepts exactly zz_billing_stock_and_gate:commercial.hook_dispensing():7:O and applies after Billing; ORD-12's prescription-refills suite passes with Billing before or after 0154; 0154 at 9d41866c refused after Billing only by its own pin of pharmacy.dispensings' five triggers); the Emergency board applies after Billing; suites that fail only because another department's rows or functions are present (to be re-joined at integration): doctors-start-readings, role-permission-changes and sealed-qa-front-desk-nurse with Appointments' or the Emergency board's role rows, own-facility-pharmacy-lab-work and prescription-changes-after-dispensing with 0154; the mutation checks (the previous commercial.outstanding fails the hijack cases; a reversal matched by work item alone fails section 11; without the refill refusal, the facility-item owner check or the HID-FACILITY skip in work_item_line, their cases fail); the work list's badge query over 200,000 lines takes 0.33 ms with the index on (work_item_kind, work_item_id) and 34.8 ms without it; db:test-runner 15 of 15; scripts/tests 82 and 1 skipped; deployment core 25; release compatibility 3. Not re-run: scripts/tuf-staging-migration-rehearsal.mjs and npm run check:db (the coordinator's harness), ehr-api and pharmacy-api jest and tsc (no TypeScript changed).
